description: Undefined reference to FreeRTOS API due to missing library link
compiler_output:
main.c:(.text+0x2a): undefined reference to `vTaskDelay'
main.c:(.text+0x3e): undefined reference to `xTaskCreate'
main.c:(.text+0x4a): undefined reference to `vTaskStartScheduler'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
user_question: Why am I getting undefined reference errors for FreeRTOS functions?
expected_root_cause: FreeRTOS library not linked - missing -lfreertos in linker flags
expected_fix: Add FreeRTOS library to linker command: -lfreertos or ensure FreeRTOS source is compiled and linked

expected_compiler_messages.suggested_fix: Add -lfreertos to linker flags or include FreeRTOS source in build

expected_follow_up_required: Verify FreeRTOSConfig.h is present and correct for target MCU
